harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: LDAP is operational on node1 for dc=branch,dc=test. The staged directory was imported unchanged, node2 finds both users, writes require the authenticated administrator, and anonymous writes fail. Both nodes passed sequential reboot and recovery validation.
actions_performed: Installed Ubuntu-supported OpenLDAP 2.6.10 packages without changing Ubuntu 24.04.3 or kernel 6.8.0-71.
Configured cn=admin,dc=branch,dc=test as the write administrator and retained anonymous read access.
Imported the staged base, people OU, alex, and sam entries.
Verified administrator updates and anonymous-write rejection.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually, proving changed boot identities and recovery after each restart.

evidence.requirement: Import staged identities and mail addresses unchanged
evidence.summary: Shows the source LDIF, successful import of all four entries, and final exact alex/sam identities and mail addresses.

evidence.requirement: Node2 can search the people subtree and find both users
evidence.summary: Remote searches from node2 return Alex North and Sam West before and after restarts.

evidence.requirement: Updates require an authenticated administrator; anonymous writes fail
evidence.summary: Shows administrator-only write ACL, rejected anonymous modification with no residual value, and successful authenticated administrator update after restart.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel remain unchanged with compatible software
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain Ubuntu 24.04.3 with kernel 6.8.0-71; distribution-supported OpenLDAP 2.6.10 is active.

evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart and LDAP recovery
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline; safe reboot acknowledgement; boot ID changed from e8afb731-420c-4162-a989-583aca271335 to 4a93a66c-0cdf-4ecd-9803-c750fc13717b; slapd, listener, directory data, and ACL recovered.

evidence.requirement: Node2 mandatory restart and remote-search recovery
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline; safe reboot acknowledgement; boot ID changed from dfeb3b70-bc1e-4ce9-90d0-9c9c853416e7 to 9f4ca36e-0d4a-4d9d-9f5c-5a74fcd3f2d6; LDAP client and remote directory search recovered.
